notes: Unit-of-measure master data and conversion factors (e.g. EA, KG, L, BOX), keyed by the composite (fromUnit, toUnit). v1 had no api_method; 'get_unit_of_measures' is synthesized to satisfy the schema-required field — the generic ERP-REST adapter routes by api_endpoint, so api_method is a documentation label here. Conversion ratios (unitMultDiv, unitRate) drive multi-UOM inventory/purchasing/sales. Referenced by inventory_items (baseUom), purchase_orders/sales_orders/customer_sales_prices (uom). No row (0 of 43) carries lastModifiedDateTime, so there is no watermark and every sync is a full re-fetch.
